key_insight: A rig-aware pipeline that combines calibrated three-camera video capture with Gaussian splatting produces fast, high-fidelity interactive 3D models of vehicle undercarriages from drive-over footage.
problem_solved: Automates and democratizes undercarriage inspection by removing the need for manual crouching/crawling and adding rich 3D views for inspectors and online buyers where undercarriage photos are rarely available.
method: Three-camera rig captures synchronized video as vehicles drive over a fixed imaging rig; rig geometry and motion are explicitly modeled for robust multi-view alignment.
Calibrate poses and fuse frames into a dense representation using Gaussian splatting to reconstruct a high-quality, renderable 3D undercarriage model.
Produce an interactive viewer that supports rotating, zooming, and slicing/cross-section inspection for detailed visual assessment.
impact: Provides a practical, scalable solution for automated vehicle inspection and e-commerce transparency; demonstrates how rig-aware calibration + Gaussian splatting can deliver fast, high-quality 3D reconstructions from constrained, real-world capture setups.
